title: The degree-one recurrence for opposite source-Hom mates
statement: In the setting of [def-sf-native-hom-source-shift-data], additionally assume tensoring is additive in both variables. Fix M in D and write H(X)=ihom(X.unop,M) on the triangulated opposite D^op. Write b_n(X) for the raw siteHomOppositeSourceShift(X.unop,n) evaluated at M. For every integer m and X in D^op, b_(m+1)(X)=(-1)^m times H(shiftFunctorAdd_op(m,1).hom_X) followed by b_1(X[m]), the shift by 1 of b_m(X), and shiftFunctorAdd(m,1).inv_(H(X)). Only the second parameter 1 is asserted; this statement contains neither the zero law nor arbitrary two-parameter addition nor the quadratic-sign correction.

source.place: Tags 08J9 and 08JC, tensor-Hom adjunction and lemma-RHom-triangulated; explicit native mate calculation, agent expansion.

proof.text: Use the defining left maps a(K,r)=c(K,r) followed by t(K,r) inverse of [def-sf-native-hom-source-shift-data]. Compare the direct left map for r=-(m+1) with the two maps for r=-m and r=-1. Expand c and t by their CommShift addition equations. Apply CommShift₂Int.comm once to interchange the parameter shift -m with the argument shift -1. Its scalar is (-1)^((-m)(-1))=(-1)^m, and its shiftComm term restores the opposite shift order. All remaining shift comparison factors cancel by naturality and the shift-addition associativity equation. This is the degree-one specialization of step 2 of lem-sf-native-hom-signed-shift-laws; it is the remaining tensor calculation, not an assumed shift structure on internal Hom.

Apply conjugateEquiv_comp to the left composite and the tensor-Hom adjunctions. Whiskered tensor maps transpose to whiskered source-Hom mates. The shift adjunction triangle identities cancel the adjacent unit/counit pairs. The tensor map of the parameter compositor transposes to precomposition by shiftFunctorAdd on D^op; the output compositor becomes shiftFunctorAdd.inv on D. Move the integer unit scalar through the additive functors. Finally perform the specified transports -(-m)=m and -(-1)=1. The result is exactly the displayed degree-one recurrence, including when m is negative. At m=0 the zero unitors cancel; at m=-1 this states the signed inverse relation.

proof_origin.note: Degree-one specialization of the existing source-mate tensor interchange calculation. All other cases are proved by integer induction in the parent module.

from.place: Proof, second paragraph: internal Hom is triangulated in the first variable and the exact comparison pullback carries triangles to triangles, so the comparison maps form morphisms of triangles. This node supplies the native signed shifts used in that clause.

lean.statement:
theorem siteHom_opposite_source_shift_successor (M : D) (m : ℤ) (X : Dᵒᵖ) :
    (siteHomOppositeSourceShift X.unop (m + 1)).hom.app M =
      m.negOnePow •
        ((MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj M).map
            ((shiftFunctorAdd Dᵒᵖ m 1).hom.app X) ≫
          (siteHomOppositeSourceShift (X⟦m⟧).unop 1).hom.app M ≫
          ((siteHomOppositeSourceShift X.unop m).hom.app M)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd D m 1).inv.app ((ihom X.unop).obj M))
